method: exact integer-grid / rational shared-joint microscope; train-only selection, post-commit test V&V

007bbfb7.backward_nonzero_rule: for each observed nonzero output c in {2,4,6,7}, P((macro,micro)=(c,c) | Y=c)=1
007bbfb7.interpretation: The shared callosal joint is deterministic forward but intentionally non-invertible locally at Y=0. Two training-compatible symbolic programs remain, but they induce one complete held-out prediction, so prediction singularity is reached without program singularity.

d037b0a7.backward_rule: collapse each constant nonzero downward column-run to its first nonzero source marker
d037b0a7.interpretation: A small generic directional candidate family is resolved exactly by the training evidence. The selected forward rule fills each column downward from its latest nonzero marker; the training-side reverse map reconstructs every source grid exactly.

claim_boundary.established_here: The proposed bidirectional callosal semantics is executable and exact on these two real ARC task microscopes, and it exposes useful ambiguity/singularity distinctions.
claim_boundary.not_established: This is not yet a general ARC-AGI-1/2 solver or evidence that the bidirectional method automatically discovers the required semantic representation on arbitrary tasks. The candidate families in this microscope are deliberately small and generic but hand-selected for the experiment.
